objects_and_assumptions.text: Let n be an arbitrary natural number. The witness m must also be a natural number.

statement_or_definition.text: For each natural number n there is a natural number m such that m = n + 1 and n < m.

reasoning_steps.text: Choose n + 1 as the witness after introducing n. Reflexivity gives the equality.
Use Nat.lt_succ_self n to establish the strict inequality n < n + 1.
